features.description: AI assistant for everyday tasks - writing, studying, planning, math, coding, and image/file analysis - that remembers context within a chat.
Editable writing blocks for drafts plus code blocks you can read, edit, copy, preview, or run (including Python) inside responses.

features.feature: Message actions (copy, read aloud, try again)
features.description: Buttons under a response can include Copy, Good/Bad response, Read aloud, Share, and Try again (regenerate).
Editing a sent prompt and resending is long-standing ChatGPT behavior but is not documented on current help pages (unverified).
ChatGPT shows live working status while it thinks or runs tools; no help page documents the indicator itself (unverified).
GPT-6 composes answers combining text, visuals, and interactive elements (buttons, forms, charts) directly in the conversation.
Choose among models such as GPT-6 (Sol on Plus/Pro, Luna on Free/Go) and GPT-5.6 variants, depending on plan.
Choose how much ChatGPT thinks per response; the Pro reasoning option uses GPT-6 Astra.
Speak with ChatGPT and hear spoken responses inside a chat; the Live option (GPT-Live) listens and speaks at once and can use web search and memory.
Advanced and Standard voice retire from ChatGPT Voice on December 11, 2026, leaving GPT-Live as the voice model.
The microphone icon records audio that ChatGPT turns into editable text.
Upload documents, spreadsheets, presentations, images, and audio to analyze, summarize, or transform.
Saved files in one place, organized into folders, with PIN-locked protected files; ask ChatGPT to work across a folder's files; Space replaces Library on eligible accounts.
Home for pages, uploaded files, and other work: create and edit pages with ChatGPT, organize in spaces, and share to collaborate (Pro/Business/Enterprise; Slides rolling out).
Create, edit, save, and manage images with ChatGPT Images.
Inspect uploaded data, create tables and charts, and review code-backed results.
ChatGPT searches the web, cites sources, and can use location information.
Shop from images, virtually try on clothing and accessories, and save products for later.
Plan, research, and synthesize complex questions into a documented report.
ChatGPT agent autonomously completes multi-step, browser-based tasks.
One-time or recurring tasks (daily briefs, package or email monitoring) created, reviewed, and shared under the Scheduled tab.
Settings > Notifications offers push and email notifications, e.g., for scheduled-task completions.
Keep related chats, files, and instructions together so ChatGPT reuses the context; start on one device and continue on another.
Remembers preferences and details from past chats, saved memories, custom instructions, Library/Space files, and connected apps; manage in Settings > Personalization.
Persistent instructions about you and how ChatGPT should respond, applied to every chat.
Choose a ChatGPT personality and adjust response warmth, enthusiasm, formatting, and emoji use.
Custom versions of ChatGPT with their own instructions, files, and actions, shared via the GPT Store; being retired with creators migrating to plugins (standard retirement December 11, 2026).
Reusable bundles of custom instructions, reference files, and connected apps, usable across Chat, Work, and Codex.
Connect services like Google Drive or Slack so ChatGPT can find files, summarize documents, or act in the connected service.
Connect and manage custom MCP servers for additional tools.

No standalone Canvas feature is documented in the current help collection; inline drafting and code editing happen via writing blocks, Space pages, and desktop site tools (unverified whether a canvas view persists).
Step-by-step tutoring with hints and practice instead of direct answers.
Create, review, and edit flashcards; revisit saved decks in your library.
Capture and summarize meetings and voice notes.
An always-on agent with its own computer and connected apps that keeps working between conversations; rolling out to Pro users 18+ (not EEA/UK/Switzerland); pausable.
Call or message ChatGPT by phone in the US, including WhatsApp messaging.
Sidebar search (Ctrl/Cmd+K) finds chats, projects, images, and files, and can include connected Google Drive content.
Delete chats permanently or archive them out of the sidebar; archived chats stay in your account and remain searchable.
Chats that don't appear in history, aren't used to train models, and don't feed memory.
Create a link to a read-only snapshot of a conversation (or share a scheduled task).
Manage model-training participation, chat history, and account data settings.
Request a copy of your ChatGPT data and transfer exported conversations between accounts.
Chat history syncs across web, iOS, Android, and desktop when signed in to the same account.
New unified ChatGPT desktop app for macOS and Windows combining Chat, Work, and Codex.
Browse, sign in, download files, and review pages without leaving the desktop app.
Search, edit, and complete tasks on supported websites without leaving the app.
Capture screenshots to discuss with ChatGPT on Mac.
Start or resume voice conversations with ChatGPT from Apple CarPlay.
Use your ChatGPT plan in participating third-party apps and sites.
Connect financial accounts (US) to review spending, balances, and subscriptions.
Health-focused help with dedicated privacy and data controls.
Legal research capabilities and legal plugins.
Add a card and review and approve purchases ChatGPT makes for you.
Designate a trusted contact who can be alerted and help with account safety.
Link a teen account and manage parental controls in a teen-safe experience.
Surfaces crisis-support resources when a conversation suggests someone may be in danger.
Create, publish, and manage websites and apps with ChatGPT Sites.
ChatGPT for Excel, Google Sheets, Word, and PowerPoint to build, edit, and polish documents and spreadsheets.
